subject: reasoning
question: Qadir starts from Point A and drives 1 km towards East. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 8 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Qadir starts from Point A and drives 1 km towards East.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns left and drives 8 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/100e8c4e86c17c32e233d472fd21ce45e5c66b51f4214f13010353624c4b323e.png] 

So, He should drive **4 km to the North** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
